import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between megapixels and price, colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    style='has_video_4k',
    palette='viridis',
    s=100,
    alpha=0.7
)

# Add labels and title
scatter_plot.set_title('Megapixels vs Price by Sensor Type and 4K Video Capability', fontsize=16)
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)
scatter_plot.legend(title='Sensor Type / 4K Video', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11', loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
